name: annotated-text
title: Annotated Text
description: Inline words marked up by hand: wavy and double underlines, a highlighter, a circle, a box, brackets, an arrow and cross-outs, with slightly irregular strokes that draw themselves when they scroll into view.
label: Componentry by Harsh Jadhav
author: Harsh Jadhav <https://harshjdhv.com>
attribution: Componentry, Copyright (c) 2026 Harsh Jadhav. MIT License.

props.name: children
props.description: The words to annotate. Kept on one line (no wrapping) so the drawing lines up; keep it to a short phrase.

props.name: color
props.description: A Tailwind text color class for the mark, for example "text-rose-400". Each variant has its own default.

props.name: animate
props.description: Draw the mark once when a quarter of it enters the viewport. Off, or under reduced motion, the mark is simply there.

props.name: delay
props.description: Seconds before drawing starts. A mark with two strokes draws the second 160 ms later.

props.name: duration
props.description: Seconds each stroke takes to draw.

a11y: The marks are decoration: every drawing is aria-hidden and ignores the pointer, and the words stay plain text for screen readers and selection.

A mark carries no meaning for assistive technology. When it means something (deleted text, a key term), wrap the words in the right element as well, for example <del> inside a strikethrough or <mark> inside a highlight.
Under prefers-reduced-motion the marks are drawn from the start, with no animation.
Right to left: the marks are mirrored and drawn from the inline start, so an arrow points along the reading direction.
